summary: Split provisioning request: delayed laptop shipment with temporary VPN/service-account bridge
description:
Issue summary:
A new hire (Platform PM) starting 2026-03-15 will be remote-in-region (EMEA) but their company-leased laptop will not arrive until 2026-03-22 due to courier delays. HR requests a temporary, minimal-privilege bridge (VPN + short-lived service account + company loaner laptop hold) so the hire can complete initial orientation and training without exposing production secrets.

Impact:
- Orientation kickoff on 2026-03-16 depends on access to internal wiki and Slack.
- Delay could push critical setup tasks and PM ramp by ~1 week if no temporary access granted.

Background and ask:
- HR has approved loaner laptop policy exception for this hire but needs ops to: 1) issue a timeboxed VPN credential tied to a short-lived service account, 2) create a bridge service account scoped to read-only org wiki and ticketing, 3) place a laptop shipping hold and mark asset as loaner pending arrival, and 4) document audit trail for later deprovisioning.
- They also want confirmation on whether loaner device requires additional MDM enrollment steps for EMEA region.

Steps attempted so far:
1) HR contacted Logistics partner who confirmed courier delay and requested formal ticket for exception.
2) Security provided a draft least-privilege role suggestion (read-only wiki, Slack access, no code repo or prod infra).
3) IT inventory shows three available loaner MacBook M2 units in us-west pool (serials listed privately).

Requested by HR (acceptance criteria):
- Bridge VPN credentials issued with strict expiry (7 days) and enforced conditional access (MFA required).
- Short-lived service account created with RBAC scoped to onboarding resources; documented in ticket.
- Loaner laptop reserved with asset tag annotated and shipping hold placed.
- Owner for automatic revocation scheduled (deprovision action) and confirmation logged before new employee's laptop arrives.

Policy question:
- Does Redwood require rekeying KMS or additional encryption controls when issuing a corporate loaner to a remote EMEA hire, or is standard MDM + disk encryption sufficient for a 7-day window?

Attachments / artifacts referenced:
- Logistics courier tracking screenshot (uploaded to HR drive)
- Security draft least-privilege role (link above in related confluence)

Urgency and suggested next steps:
- HR requests decision and actions by 2026-03-12 EOD to meet orientation schedule.
- Recommend short sync between IT, Security, and HR to finalize RBAC and loaner process, followed by ops action to create credentials and asset reservation.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Ethan Clarke: Acknowledged. I'll validate inventory and check loaner MDM compliance for EMEA. Can Security paste the least-privilege role JSON here?

2026-03-10 13:45 - Priya Desai (Security): Dropped proposed role: onboarding_bridge_readonly. No repo or infra perms. Recommending MFA and conditional access. KMS rekey not required for disk-encrypted corporate devices per current policy, but confirm with Legal for cross-border custody.
2026-03-11 09:05 - Logistics (Automated): Three loaner units reserved in us-west pool. Shipping hold annotated: HOLD-INT-334455. Awaiting ops pickup authorization.

2026-03-11 14:32 - Ethan Clarke: Confirmed VPN token issuance flow. Will create a temporary service account with 7-day TTL and tie it to conditional access. Planning deprovision job for 2026-03-23.
Action items: create account, issue VPN token, annotate asset, notify HR when complete.

2026-03-12 08:58 - Samira Khan (HR): Thank you. Two follow-ups from hiring manager: 1) If device is shipped, can loaner be collected remotely or should the hire return it to HQ? 2) Who signs the chain-of-custody?
investigation_notes: Checked inventory: 3 available MacBook M2 loaners in us-west (serials masked in ticket).
Security assessed the temporary service account scope; no elevated permissions identified. MFA + conditional access enforced by default.
Logistics confirmed cross-border courier delay is due to customs paperwork; estimated delivery 2026-03-22.
next_steps: Security to confirm whether Legal sign-off is needed for cross-border loaner custody (by 2026-03-12 EOD).
IT/Ops (Ethan) to create short-lived service account with 7-day TTL and issue VPN credentials (target 2026-03-12).
Logistics to annotate loaner asset tag and prepare loaner shipment hold until HR provides final shipping instructions.
Onboarding owner to confirm chain-of-custody policy for remote return or in-person collection; record decision on Confluence page.
